React 18.2.0, React DOM 18.2.0, Scheduler and JSX runtime: Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates (original files: Facebook, Inc. and its affiliates). MIT license. The runtime is extracted from the already-installed Jupyter Notebook distribution's unmodified upstream runtime modules; the small module loader and ESM facades are Agent Forge code. No Notebook application modules are included. File and source hashes are recorded in MANIFEST.json. This is an offline runtime bundle, not an upstream npm tarball and not a fabricated npm lock file.
